snippet.title: MULLET MADJACK – Launch Trailer – Out April 30 on Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
Pre-orders and a demo are available now: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/mullet-madjack-switch/

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://www.nintendo.com/us/

MULLET MADJACK is a HIGH-OCTANE-ACTION SHOOTER that put you directly inside a CLASSIC ANIME. Pick your favorite weapon and reach the last floor. Beat your best time or try again. Haste makes waste… OF YOUR ENEMIES!

#anime #oldschool #indiedev #gamedev #indiegame
